subject: Entrance & Exit Controls: Clearance and Training Evidence for SOC2 Review

Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: entrance/exit controls and personnel screening evidence for SOC 2 walk-through

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. As part of Brightwood Health's SOC 2 engagement we need a compact packet showing your personnel lifecycle controls focused on: background checks, security awareness training cadence/completion, role-based access changes at exit, and a sample offboarding evidence trail.

Requested artifacts (short list):
- Summary of background check types and vendor names used for hires (redaction ok)
- Training roster and completion records for the last 12 months (including quarterly refresh for SRE/Prod teams)
- Example of an exit workflow and a redacted record showing access removal (timestamped)
- Evidence of periodic attestation or manager sign-off for new joiners

We only need representative files — a few samples and one complete workflow record is fine. Delivery requested by end of next week (Mar 1) to keep the audit timeline. If you can bundle as simple PDFs/CSV and provide any internal ticket/drive links, that will help.

Best,
Maya Singh
Sage Audit — Client Services

Subject: Entrance & Exit Controls: Clearance and Training Evidence (attached)

Maya / Brightwood team —

Attached is the representative packet for the personnel lifecycle controls you requested. Contents (redacted where appropriate):
- training_roster_q1_2026-2027.pdf — course list, completion timestamps, and manager attestations for employees in scope.
- redacted_background_log_2026.csv — redacted hire records with vendor and check type.
- offboarding-checklist-template.xlsx — our standard offboarding checklist plus an example ticket id: HR-4529 (redacted user id: user_####) and IAM log timestamp that shows account deprovisioning on 2026-11-17T13:04:22Z.

A few implementation notes:
- Background checks: vendor is ClearHire; full scope for full-time hires, limited checks for contractors. All checks have an internal record with manager attestation at hire.
- Training: security awareness is required on day 30 and quarterly thereafter for Prod/SRE; rosters include completion flags and manager sign-off.
- Offboarding: ticket HR-4529 includes sign-off from manager and IT deprovision task; IAM logs are retained for 18 months per policy.

Links for reviewer convenience: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-evidence (contains source exports) and DocuSign link for our personnel attestation policy.

If you need any additional samples (full logs, unredacted under an NDA, or the vendor contract), let me know and we can coordinate next steps.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: training_roster_q1_2026-2027.pdf, redacted_background_log_2026.csv, offboarding-checklist-template.xlsx
